headline: Binance Intake Rises To 1,283.4 Million Dollars From 323.4 Million
narrative: Binance took in 1,283.4 million dollars over 24 hours, up from 323.4 million dollars, which means the largest stream of money is arriving at a venue where holders can sell. Clean-asset intake across 79 venues rose to 2,523.1 million dollars, 0.9159 percent of the 275.5 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 1,423.2 million dollars. Bitget took in 917.6 million dollars and Gate took in 261.7 million dollars, while OKX posted a 121.4 million dollar outflow, the largest departure.
author: jordan
